property_summary: A second call to fallback with msg.value == 10 ether at a block.timestamp equal to (or not greater than) the stored pastBlockTime must revert; the mutant deleted that require, so it accepts such a call, updating pastBlockTime and differing in observable state/revert behavior.
change_summary: Delete the require `block.timestamp > pastBlockTime` so calls in the same timestamp (e.g., same block) no longer revert, letting pastBlockTime update in cases where P would revert.
